statements.sql: SELECT order_id AS "ORDER_ID", user_id AS "USER_ID", ts AS "TS", price AS "PRICE", price * 1.2 AS "PRICE_WITH_TAX" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."ORDERS" LIMIT 1000
SELECT country AS "COUNTRY", user_id AS "USER_ID", age AS "AGE" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."USERS" LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN(ts) as min_date,
  MAX(ts) as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."ORDERS"

SELECT user_id AS "USER_ID"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."USERS"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, ts AS "TS", price AS "PRICE"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."ORDERS"
  ON user_id = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND ts <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND ts > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE ts <= ?
AND ts > ?
